name: vscode-ncon
description: Napkin Concept Object Notation: syntax highlighting, embedded JavaScript in Code bodies, and rainbow nesting by depth.

ncon.rainbow.enabled.description: Color every head and its parentheses by nesting depth.

ncon.rainbow.boldHeads.description: Draw heads (the Concept names before a parenthesis) in bold.

ncon.rainbow.colors.description: One color per nesting level, cycling. Monokai by default.

ncon.palette.enabled.description: Paint strings, comments, variables, names and numbers in Monokai whatever the theme. Off leaves them to the theme.

ncon.locals.binders.description: Heads whose first argument names a local, e.g. Bind($x, value, body). The local and every use of it in the body are drawn white.

enumDescriptions: This extension paints the parentheses in the Monokai rainbow, like the heads.
VS Code's own bracket pair colorization paints the parentheses; heads keep the Monokai rainbow. Also set "[ncon]": { "editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": true }.
